baseline.note: Latest main was used. The intervening main change is the reviewed identity-bridge merge and does not change the mechanics conclusions in this audit.

scope.purpose: Fix the Raw fact-retention contract before 271-equipment horizontal breadth; do not implement formulas or runtime support.

constraints: configured fact, derived mechanic, empirical measurement, and global formula remain separate

observations: ConfiguredAttackVariants has four occurrences.

Observed fields include AttackSequence, AttackAnimationTimeDurationSeconds, DamageDelaySeconds, Damage, DamageType, DamageSplashMultiplier, CooldownSeconds, AttackVariantResetMultiplier, VariantLoopAmount, and VariantActiveEffect.
Configured animation durations are approximately 0.15, 0.15, 0.15, 0.125 seconds and configured damage is 25 for each occurrence.
AttackDefintion includes AttackRateSeconds ~= 0.6 and ProjectileDefinition.
AnimNotifyStateData contains bow/crossbow fire, charge, load and shoot notify-state names.
Projectile definition includes projectile count and per-projectile delay.
Linked projectile package contains a decoded damage FloatProperty of 50; source damage can live outside the item-instance package.
melee-instance-animation-duration-v1: 293 matched facts across 24 resolved entities.
ranged-instance-attack-rate-v1: 29 matched facts across 19 resolved entities, with 38 mapped gaps.
Current coverage is evidence that timing fields are structurally harvestable but not yet horizontally closed.
Melee Formal Value currently represents configured attack occurrences, configured damage, and configured animation duration.
Ranged Formal Value currently represents projectile velocity, projectile definitions/count, angle, per-projectile delay, pushback and friendly-fire facts.
It does not yet represent DamageDelay, attack/reset/recovery/loop controls, AttackRateSeconds, notify timing, damage channel/family eligibility, or cooldown composition.
Formal relations already distinguish Scatter Crossbow -> projectile, Battle Robe -> gear actor, and Death Cap Mushroom -> gameplay effect.
Relation representation can be reused conceptually, but linked target value population remains narrow.
Fighter's Bindings fixed combo: 4 hits / 0.575 s = 6.95652173913 HPS at the audited unmodified cadence.
Sickles: 6 hits / 1.7 s = 3.52941176471 HPS.
Master's Katana: 3 hits / 1.56 s = 1.92307692308 HPS.
Anchor / Encrusted Anchor: 1 hit / 2.5 s = 0.4 HPS.
Mechanized/Broken Sawblade are explicitly not derivable by a fixed-combo model because release/continuous/overheat behavior needs a cycle model.
Death Cap Mushroom has a current-audit base cooldown of 30 s, source-backed by the game-derived database, while its duration formula remains a model assumption.
Multiple artifacts retain multi-power published sample counts, but the audit explicitly does not promote a transferable Power curve.
Battle Robe intrinsic properties include -40% artifact cooldown and +30% melee damage.
The audit already records cooldown ownership/composition and melee-damage modifier stage as unresolved model boundaries.
Cool Down tiers in the game-file-derived repository audit are -18%, -29%, -37%, stackable with up to four copies.
Multiple-copy composition, Battle Robe composition and current Wiki 38% display conflict remain unsupported by runtime.
Shin separates flat physical, full physical multiplier, indirect, elemental-focus and all-damage full-multiplier families, with special eligibility cases such as Jungle Poison.
Shin/Pancakecat provide HPS/DPS measurements suitable for calibration, not game-file promotion.
Pancakecat has an averaged HPS sheet; the existing summary had not fully recovered its cell definitions/metadata.
dungeons.tools states weapons share an identical gear-power curve and compares item-relative Power ratings.
It states the absolute gear-power curve is compiled into the executable rather than shipped in paks.
This is a public game-derived database claim, not direct proof of the executable implementation.
The public Sword page exposes a same-item multi-power damage table from power 1 through 108 plus base damage and per-hit attack durations.
The page notes displayed damage can vary at the same power level, so reconstruction must account for rounding/roll ranges.
Current page lists -18%, -29%, -38% and says stacking has diminishing effect.
History says stacking behavior changed in 1.8.0.0 and four copies became possible in 1.17.0.0.
Its maximum-stack trivia is counter-evidence against blindly using a simple product of displayed reductions as the confirmed current formula.
Cooldown Shot is a charged-shot trigger with fixed reductions 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 seconds.
It is therefore a state transition on remaining cooldown, not the same family as percentage cooldown reduction.
A 2026 community formula uses Full * [(100% + Additive) * (Base * Multiplicative + Dynamo) + Indirect].
This is a useful hypothesis consistent with Shin-style family separation, not a confirmed game formula.
A 2021 community test proposed a post-1.8 formula separating armor reduction from an enchantment diminishing-return accumulator.
Version age and current 1.17 four-copy behavior prevent promotion without current cross-checks.

candidateFormula.note: The item-relative coefficient may be represented by different serialized/configured facts per mechanic; do not equate a UI Power rating with every Raw per-hit Damage field without cross-validation.

candidateFormula.empiricalBoundary: input cancel windows, actual recovery and continuous sawblade overheat/release behavior are not assumed from duration alone

preBreadthGaps.fact: A source-backed traversal/retention contract for linked animation/notify/effect timing facts.
preBreadthGaps.whyNeededBeforeBreadth: Current representative Raw proves timing is distributed across configured variants, attack-rate fields and relations; exceptional families cannot be safely reduced to one duration field. If breadth stores only currently-Formal fields, a later HPS model would require re-harvesting.
preBreadthGaps.howToAcquire: Use the already committed Raw Structural Inventory and relation graph to census timing-like fields reachable from each category seed; record exact field paths or explicit unavailable/parser-boundary states. No Raw re-extraction, Native work or runtime capture is required for this gate.

preBreadthGaps.fact: For each Artifact, locate source-backed base cooldown/start semantics in committed Raw/linked packages or record that the fact is not statically observed.
preBreadthGaps.whyNeededBeforeBreadth: Base cooldown is per-item input. Current public audit has values, but the representative full Raw item/effect path does not establish a generic Raw source location. Losing this distinction would mix database facts with Raw facts.
preBreadthGaps.howToAcquire: Search committed structural inventory across Artifact instance, actor/effect and inherited related packages for cooldown fields; preserve the relation/provenance chain or an explicit not-observed/parser-boundary classification.

currentFormalCanRepresent: serialized relation targets for representative slices
semanticGaps: global gear-power curve / derived displayed value layer
cooldown source ownership, percentage/fixed/reset families and state transitions

finalDecision.rationale: Formula fitting itself can wait, but the horizontal collector must first guarantee preservation of linked timing facts and per-Artifact base-cooldown provenance. These are per-item inputs; omitting them would force a second breadth harvest.
finalDecision.unblockCondition: Close the two source-closure gates using the already committed structural inventory and freeze the category-specific required-before-breadth fact contract.
